summary: Kyndryl Holdings, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a two-tranche offering of senior unsecured notes: an unspecified principal amount of senior notes due 20xx and a second series due 20xx, with coupon rates, maturities, and gross proceeds left blank in the preliminary filing. The notes are unguaranteed obligations of Kyndryl, ranking pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt, issued under the 2021 base indenture with third and fourth supplemental indentures. Joint book-running managers are J.P. Morgan, Citigroup, and Morgan Stanley. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation, with pricing terms to be set at launch.
